strongest_defensible_contribution: A governed, condition-aware, engine-disjoint FD002 anomaly-alert pipeline that froze preprocessing, detector, calibration, and alert policy before internal held-out access and transparently reports proxy-sensitive FAR, coverage, and delay with independent reproduction.

claims.proposed_paper_wording: Development and confirmatory evaluation used deterministic, engine-disjoint FD002 partitions.
claims.limitations: One fixed 60/20/20 split does not estimate split-to-split variability.
claims.permitted_wording: A deterministic engine-disjoint split was used, with 156 training, 52 validation, and 52 internal held-out engines.
claims.prohibited_or_exaggerated_wording: Randomized robustness across many fleet splits was established.

claims.proposed_paper_wording: A training-fitted P1/K=6 condition-aware preprocessing pipeline was implemented and reproduced.
claims.limitations: K=6 is a validation-selected context representation, not proof of six causal physical regimes.
claims.permitted_wording: P1/K=6 scales sensors with training-fitted, operating-mode-aware state and assigns endpoint mode from registered cycle context.
claims.prohibited_or_exaggerated_wording: The method discovered six true physical operating regimes or introduced a novel clustering algorithm.

claims.proposed_paper_wording: Multiple classical and deep anomaly detectors were compared under registered validation protocols.
claims.limitations: Model selection and the 1,280-policy study used validation proxy evidence; cross-family uncertainty is limited.
claims.permitted_wording: PCA, LOF, One-Class SVM, Isolation Forest, and an LSTM autoencoder were compared on registered validation proxies.
claims.prohibited_or_exaggerated_wording: The project exhaustively proved one detector family is universally best.

claims.proposed_paper_wording: A frozen three-seed calibrated LSTM ensemble was evaluated as the unfused confirmatory comparator.
claims.limitations: Three seeds do not characterize all training variance; the LSTM was a comparator, not the selected primary detector.
claims.permitted_wording: The pre-registered three-seed LSTM ensemble was evaluated without score or decision fusion.
claims.prohibited_or_exaggerated_wording: The LSTM was selected after held-out access, was the primary model, or proved deep-learning superiority.

claims.proposed_paper_wording: A predeclared threshold, EWMA, and persistence grid containing 1,280 candidates was studied on validation proxies.
claims.limitations: The grid was not searched on internal held-out results, and its coverage is bounded by its registered candidate set.
claims.permitted_wording: The frozen validation study evaluated 1,280 registered alert candidates across five proxy policies.
claims.prohibited_or_exaggerated_wording: The held-out split was searched to optimize the alert policy.

claims.proposed_paper_wording: The frozen PCA policy achieved endpoint false-alert rates below 6% for all three registered internal held-out endpoint proxies.
claims.limitations: The rates are proxy-labelled internal held-out results, not physical-onset, official-test, or production estimates.
claims.permitted_wording: Endpoint FAR was 3.2440%, 0.9443%, and 0.5153% for final-10%, final-20%, and final-30% proxies, respectively.
claims.prohibited_or_exaggerated_wording: Operational false-alarm probability is below 6% in real aircraft.

claims.proposed_paper_wording: The aggregate median 12-cycle detection-delay aspiration was not achieved.
claims.limitations: Delay is measured from heuristic normalized-life proxy onsets; missed engines and proxy choice affect interpretation.
claims.permitted_wording: Aggregate median held-out delay was 25 cycles; only final-10% had median delay exactly 12 cycles.
claims.prohibited_or_exaggerated_wording: The system reliably detects degradation within 12 cycles.

claims.proposed_paper_wording: Coverage, ranking, FAR, and delay varied materially with the registered proxy anomaly-onset definition.
claims.limitations: The proxies are three late-life fractions, not independent physical onset annotations.
claims.permitted_wording: Results are proxy-sensitive: PCA coverage ranged from 51.92% to 84.62% and median delay from 12 to 42.5 cycles.
claims.prohibited_or_exaggerated_wording: The metrics estimate accuracy against true fault onset.

claims.proposed_paper_wording: On every frozen endpoint proxy, PCA produced lower false-alert rates than the LSTM comparator, with lower engine coverage and longer median delay.
claims.limitations: This is a two-detector internal held-out trade-off, not general superiority or external generalization.
claims.permitted_wording: The PCA policy generalized from validation selection to a lower-FAR but lower-coverage and later-alert internal held-out profile than the frozen LSTM comparator.
claims.prohibited_or_exaggerated_wording: PCA is superior, safer, or more accurate than LSTM in general.

claims.proposed_paper_wording: The LSTM comparator showed a distinct coverage-delay-FAR trade-off that may be complementary to PCA.
claims.limitations: No score fusion, decision fusion, incremental-utility test, or new pre-registered fusion study was performed.
claims.permitted_wording: The LSTM had higher coverage and slightly earlier median alerts, but also higher FAR, on each registered endpoint proxy.
claims.prohibited_or_exaggerated_wording: PCA-LSTM fusion improves performance or their errors are independently complementary.

claims.proposed_paper_wording: No model, calibration, threshold, alert policy, or fusion choice was changed after internal held-out access.
claims.limitations: This statement applies to the governed first valid run and its frozen protocol.
claims.permitted_wording: The first valid confirmatory run used the pre-registered frozen PCA primary and unfused LSTM comparator without reselection.
claims.prohibited_or_exaggerated_wording: The confirmatory result validates future tuning choices or authorizes retroactive candidate selection.

claims.proposed_paper_wording: The official NASA test set was not evaluated in this project protocol.
claims.limitations: The internal held-out partition is not the official NASA truncated test set.
claims.permitted_wording: No official NASA-test result is reported.
claims.prohibited_or_exaggerated_wording: The internal held-out metrics are NASA official-test performance.

claims.proposed_paper_wording: FD002 does not provide observed physical per-cycle fault-onset annotations; late-life labels are declared proxies.
claims.limitations: Run-to-failure degradation is present, but the exact physical onset is not annotated for this classification task.
claims.permitted_wording: The study evaluates final-10%, final-20%, and final-30% normalized-life proxy onsets.
claims.prohibited_or_exaggerated_wording: The reported delays are measured from true physical fault onset.

claims.proposed_paper_wording: The repository is a governed, reproducible research prototype with versioned protocols, hashes, synthetic contracts, and independently verified reports.
claims.limitations: Raw data and model bundles are local/ignored; there is no lockfile, production service, or external replication package yet.
claims.permitted_wording: The work is a reproducible research prototype within its registered local artifact and environment boundaries.
claims.prohibited_or_exaggerated_wording: The repository is production-ready, independently replicated by an external team, or fully reproducible without governed local artifacts.

claims.proposed_paper_wording: Faithful detector explainability has not yet been implemented.
claims.limitations: The guide specifies a reconstruction-contribution contract, but specification is not implementation.
claims.permitted_wording: Explainability is planned; no current output should be called SHAP or causal fault attribution.
claims.prohibited_or_exaggerated_wording: Explainability, SHAP, root-cause diagnosis, or validated sensor attribution is implemented.

claims.proposed_paper_wording: No production API, deployment service, or frozen end-to-end inference interface is implemented.
claims.limitations: Research workflow CLIs exist, but they are not a production inference API or deployment bundle.
claims.permitted_wording: A governed inference interface remains implementation work.
claims.prohibited_or_exaggerated_wording: The system is deployed, production-ready, real-time validated, or exposed through a supported API.
